questions.question: How much space should you leave when passing a cyclist up to 30 mph?
questions.explanation: Leave at least 1.5 metres up to 30 mph, and more above 30 mph.

questions.question: What should you do if oncoming traffic stops you giving 1.5 metres?
options: Wait behind the cyclist until clear
questions.explanation: Wait behind the cyclist whenever there is not enough room.
